wave_classification_reasons: direct rank was motivated by SHORT-01/SHORT-WAVE-02 observing that the classifier-probability threshold policy could not generate a usable short book
the universe is being widened from the 12-ETF fixed universe after observing those results
the current-registry historical seed is not point-in-time membership (see docs/research/BROAD_RESEARCH_UNIVERSE_CURRENT_TRUTH_AUDIT.md)

seed_universe.note: Frozen BEFORE any Wave-03 result is observed. This 88-symbol set is NOT historical point-in-time membership -- see docs/research/BROAD_RESEARCH_UNIVERSE_CURRENT_TRUTH_AUDIT.md. A later symbol enabled/disabled in the live registry does NOT change this frozen seed; regenerate this file explicitly (a new, separately-reviewed decision) if a future wave needs a refreshed seed.

dynamic_cross_section.policy: RANKABLE_SET(T) = seed-universe symbols with a valid OOS ml_score at exact decision timestamp T
dynamic_cross_section.note: A symbol need not have OOS coverage on every historical date (listing date, feature warm-up, data availability, walk-forward eligibility all vary). Do NOT require a symbol to exist in 2016 merely to remain in the seed -- this prevents a later IPO from being falsely projected backward. cross_section_size(T) must be recorded by the future RUN.

cache_safety.policy: Reuse a cache ONLY after fail-closed verification that manifest/content exactly matches: provider, feed, adjustment, asof, requested window, seed universe, corporate-action evidence, canonical semantic bars hash. If exact verification is unavailable, fetch fresh. No existence-only cache reuse (this is the documented SHORT-WAVE-02 lesson -- see mission 'CACHE SAFETY REPAIR FROM WAVE-02 LESSON').

cost_model.note: CONSERVATIVE RESEARCH COST ASSUMPTION, not actual Alpaca commission.

long_only_rank_weight_rule: top 5 scored names, each desired weight = +0.20
long_short_rank_weight_rule: top 5 LONG each +0.10, bottom 5 SHORT each -0.10; gross=1.0, net=0.0

RANK-01.name: single-feature OOS classifier-score cross-sectional rank, momentum-rank predictor

RANK-02.name: single-feature OOS classifier-score cross-sectional rank, short-term-reversal predictor

RANK-03.name: single-feature OOS classifier-score cross-sectional rank, gap-reversal predictor

same_features_as_wave02_disclosure: RANK-01/02/03 deliberately reuse the SAME THREE single-feature families as SHORT-WAVE-02 (ret_rank_20, ret_5, gap_pct_1) to isolate PORTFOLIO-CONSTRUCTION MECHANISM. Because the universe itself changed (12 ETFs -> 88-symbol registry seed), this does NOT purely isolate portfolio construction in isolation -- for ret_rank_20 especially, expanding the universe changes the cross-sectional feature itself (its rank is computed over a different, larger cross-section). This is documented, not hidden.

benchmark.definition: At each economic decision date, equal-weight the SAME causally rankable symbol set available to that family at that date (RANKABLE_SET(T) as defined above) -- no future membership, no holdout. Fold-reset semantics remain aligned to economic_returns.csv, mirroring SHORT-WAVE-02's build_fold_reset_benchmark convention.
benchmark.implementation_status: formula predeclared here; NOT implemented/exercised by this controller (run_wave.py raises NotImplementedError for this stage) -- per mission: 'If implementation of this benchmark requires new behavior later: STOP before interpreting Wave-03 results. Do not invent a benchmark after seeing returns.' Implementation is the Wave-03 RUN mission's job, built and reviewed before any real trial executes.

prohibited_after_predeclaration: adaptive rank_side_count/window/universe/horizon retuning based on observed results
mixing placebo trials into the real-candidate experiment id
changing the seed universe after seeing any trial result
inventing or adjusting the benchmark definition after seeing returns
claiming PROVEN_ALPHA or PROMOTION_READY for this post-hoc development study

execution_guard.note: run_wave.py's main() refuses any network-touching stage unless the literal --execute flag is present in argv. This predeclaration controller NEVER calls main() with --execute.
